functions.name: claim_due_automation_jobs
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_due_automation_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS SETOF crm_automation_queue
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$ with due as (select q.id from public.crm_automation_queue q where ((q.status in ('pending','retry') and q.scheduled_at <= now()) or (q.status = 'processing' and q.locked_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')) order by q.scheduled_at, q.created_at for update skip locked limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit,10),50))) update public.crm_automation_queue q set status='processing',locked_at=now(),attempts=q.attempts+1,updated_at=now() from due where q.id=due.id returning q.*; $function$

functions.name: claim_due_internal_automation_jobs
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_due_internal_automation_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS SETOF crm_automation_queue
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  with due as (
    select q.id
    from public.crm_automation_queue q
    where q.channel = 'internal'
      and (
        (q.status in ('pending', 'retry') and q.scheduled_at <= now())
        or (q.status = 'processing' and q.locked_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')
      )
    order by q.scheduled_at, q.created_at
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 10), 50))
  )
  update public.crm_automation_queue q
  set status = 'processing',
      locked_at = now(),
      attempts = q.attempts + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  from due
  where q.id = due.id
  returning q.*;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_crm_automation(p_dedupe_key text, p_event_type text, p_source_type text, p_source_id text, p_recipient_phone text, p_payload jsonb, p_channel text, p_scheduled_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_max_attempts integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$ declare v_id uuid; begin insert into public.crm_automation_queue(dedupe_key,event_type,source_type,source_id,recipient_phone,payload,channel,scheduled_at,max_attempts) values(p_dedupe_key,p_event_type,p_source_type,p_source_id,p_recipient_phone,coalesce(p_payload,'{}'::jsonb),p_channel,coalesce(p_scheduled_at,now()),greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_max_attempts,5),10))) on conflict(dedupe_key) do update set dedupe_key=excluded.dedupe_key returning id into v_id; return v_id; end; $function$

ingest_whatsapp_inbound_message
functions.arguments: p_provider_message_id text, p_phone_number_id text, p_contact_wa_id text, p_contact_name text, p_message_type text, p_text_body text, p_provider_timestamp timestamp with time zone, p_message_payload jsonb
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ingest_whatsapp_inbound_message(p_provider_message_id text, p_phone_number_id text, p_contact_wa_id text, p_contact_name text, p_message_type text, p_text_body text, p_provider_timestamp timestamp with time zone, p_message_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_inserted boolean := false;
begin
  if coalesce(length(trim(p_provider_message_id)), 0) = 0
     or coalesce(length(trim(p_contact_wa_id)), 0) = 0
     or coalesce(length(trim(p_message_type)), 0) = 0 then
    raise exception 'Missing required WhatsApp message fields' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  insert into public.crm_whatsapp_messages (
    provider_message_id,
    direction,
    phone_number_id,
    contact_wa_id,
    contact_name,
    message_type,
    text_body,
    provider_timestamp,
    message_payload
  ) values (
    left(trim(p_provider_message_id), 255),
    'inbound',
    nullif(left(trim(coalesce(p_phone_number_id, '')), 100), ''),
    left(trim(p_contact_wa_id), 32),
    nullif(left(trim(coalesce(p_contact_name, '')), 200), ''),
    left(trim(p_message_type), 80),
    case when p_text_body is null then null else left(p_text_body, 4000) end,
    p_provider_timestamp,
    coalesce(p_message_payload, '{}'::jsonb)
  )
  on conflict (provider_message_id) do nothing
  returning id into v_id;

  if v_id is not null then
    v_inserted := true;
  else
    select id into v_id
    from public.crm_whatsapp_messages
    where provider_message_id = left(trim(p_provider_message_id), 255);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'inserted', v_inserted);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_customer_experience_request_sent(p_experience_id uuid, p_queue_id uuid, p_provider_message_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.crm_customer_experience
  set status = 'awaiting_response',
      request_queue_id = p_queue_id,
      request_provider_message_id = nullif(left(trim(coalesce(p_provider_message_id, '')), 255), ''),
      requested_at = coalesce(requested_at, now()),
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_experience_id
    and status in ('pending_send','awaiting_response');
  return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_customer_experience_review_invited(p_experience_id uuid, p_queue_id uuid, p_provider_message_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.crm_customer_experience
  set status = 'review_invited',
      review_queue_id = p_queue_id,
      review_invited_at = coalesce(review_invited_at, now()),
      metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'review_provider_message_id', nullif(left(trim(coalesce(p_provider_message_id, '')), 255), '')
      ),
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_experience_id
    and status in ('review_pending','recovery_resolved','review_invited');
  return found;
end;
$function$

functions.name: prepare_customer_experience_recovery
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_customer_experience_recovery(p_queue_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_job public.crm_automation_queue%rowtype;
  v_exp public.crm_customer_experience%rowtype;
  v_payload jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_job
  from public.crm_automation_queue
  where id = p_queue_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_job.status <> 'processing'
     or v_job.channel <> 'internal'
     or v_job.event_type <> 'service_recovery_required'
     or v_job.source_type <> 'customer_experience' then
    return jsonb_build_object('conflict', true, 'reason', 'queue_state');
  end if;

  select * into v_exp
  from public.crm_customer_experience
  where id::text = v_job.source_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_exp.status not in ('recovery_required','recovery_in_progress') then
    return jsonb_build_object('conflict', true, 'reason', 'experience_state');
  end if;

  v_payload := coalesce(v_job.payload, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'dispatch', jsonb_build_object(
      'state', 'service_recovery_required',
      'experience_id', v_exp.id,
      'lead_name', coalesce(v_exp.first_name, 'Cliente'),
      'recipient_phone', v_exp.recipient_phone,
      'task_type', 'Recuperação de experiência',
      'service_name', coalesce(v_exp.service_name, 'Atendimento'),
      'note', left(coalesce(v_exp.response_text, 'Cliente informou que a experiência poderia melhorar.'), 500),
      'prepared_at', now()
    )
  );

  update public.crm_automation_queue
  set status = 'awaiting_operator',
      payload = v_payload,
      locked_at = null,
      last_error = null,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = v_job.id;

  update public.crm_customer_experience
  set status = 'recovery_in_progress',
      recovery_queue_id = v_job.id,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = v_exp.id;

  return jsonb_build_object('conflict', false, 'experienceId', v_exp.id, 'item', v_payload->'dispatch');
end;
$function$
